provider: Blossom servers (blossom.band / blossom.nostr.build, run by nostr.build)

free_tier.stated: 'Free uploads for everyone, from any Blossom-capable client.' 'A hard cap of 100 MiB per upload (20 MiB for free uploads), with no limit on the number of uploads or retention.'

retention.stated: 'Free uploads for everyone, from any Blossom-capable client.' 'A hard cap of 100 MiB per upload (20 MiB for free uploads), with no limit on the number of uploads or retention.'

egress.terms: unmetered, direct CDN URLs, CORS '*'. Reads 307-redirect to image.nostr.build which serves with Accept-Ranges and 206.

tooling: Blossom protocol: PUT /upload with an 'Authorization: Nostr <base64 kind-24242 event>' header signed by any self-generated secp256k1 key — no signup, no account, no email. Any Nostr client (Amethyst, Coracle, nak, blossom-server CLI) speaks it.
chaining: Identity is a pubkey you generate offline in one line of code — unlimited free identities, zero cost, zero email. Each pubkey gets its own npub1....blossom.band hostname at upload time. 20 MiB x unlimited uploads x unlimited pubkeys. At 19 MiB per object, 10 TiB = ~550,000 uploads across ~550k keys, or a few thousand keys each doing 100 uploads.

limits.value: application/zip and application/octet-stream were both 415 'File type not allowed'
application/octet-stream got 400 'Content-Type header does not match the file content'

limits_note: per-object-cap: 20 MiB for free uploads (100 MiB only on the $18/yr plan); Type gate is real and content-sniffed: application/zip and application/octet-stream were both 415 'File type not allowed'; PNG bytes sent with Content-Type: application/octet-stream got 400 'Content-Type header does not match the file content'. retention: none stated, 'no limit on ... retention'.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose, not from an identity field, and no signup was executed: er-object-cap: 20 MiB for free uploads (100 MiB only on the $18/yr plan)

reliability_note: A ~19 MiB upload returned HTTP 500 'Error uploading the file: unknown error' while 5 and 15 MiB succeeded, so the usable ceiling is somewhat below the advertised 20 MiB; one 5 MiB upload took 14 s from a user.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

extras.unit_note: free_tier.unit is 'mixed' because the headline is denominated in MiB or KiB, which the schema enum does not carry; the verbatim free_tier.stated keeps the true unit. See the storage-dossier handover.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
